name: Precedent North
summary: A fictional research-memo outline tool. Sample data, not a real research product.
paragraphs: Precedent North, in this sample, turns a question and a set of authorities the firm already trusts into an outline. It does not invent citations. A real tool that invented citations would not belong in this briefing.
The sample stops at an outline on purpose. The conclusion of a memo is the lawyer's work.
whyItMatters: An outline that starts from the firm's own authorities can cut the blank-page hour. It pays only if the lawyer spends the saved time on the judgment, not on fixing made-up sources.
pricing: Sample pricing, not a live offer.
bestFor: Readers looking at the research listing format.
